reviews.reviewText:
Important MCQs: Focus on past papers, especially questions from 1992, 1998, 1972, 1978.
Difficult MCQs: Almost 6 MCQs related to education.
Short & Long Questions: Cover education-related topics, difference and types.

MCQs easy from handouts.
Short Questions:
1. Why education is not in the Syed dynasty?
2. What are pre-literate societies?
3. Objective of government policy 1998.
Long Questions:
1. Challenges education is facing in Pakistan.
2. 5 points on the literacy 1978.
3. Differentiate between Discriminism and Volunterism.

MCQs tamam handouts se aaye aur overall paper easy tha. Short questions mein Egyptians ka influence, Sufis ka role, school as agent of change, environmental issues, educational change planning, 1947 conference objectives, University Grants Commission duties, 1978 aur 1998 policy targets aur human rights education plan se questions aaye.
